title: AIP-1 checkpoint 1: three fixes, proved by test pages
means: Checkpoint 1's review stopped after three unclean rounds. AIP-1's thread applies round 3's three Major fixes: a fixed box whose content reaches past the window fails whatever its overflow; sideways overflow clipped on body is caught; buttons are told apart by state, position and markup. For each fix it plants a test page the check must catch, and it times the crawl without the hash fast path, deleting that path if the run stays within its time limit. The off-screen bottom sheet is declined. When the check catches every planted page and passes on theOS, the review gate passes, with no fourth round.

reflection.checked: every decision before D-77 that held
